parents.name: Prism Beetle
parents.description: A small beetle refracts moonlight through its prismatic shell. Its antennae sense rhythms and steer each colored beam to match the beat.

parents.name: Echo Loom
parents.description: A portable loom weaves audible tones into threads. Each woven thread stores a vibration and releases its sound when a beam of light touches it.

candidate.bridge: The beetle's antennae convert sensed rhythms into physical threads, which are then played by the shell's refracted moonlight to create a protective sonic barrier.
candidate.description: This biomechanical crustacean possesses a translucent, prismatic carapace that functions as a living loom. As it scuttles through moonlit glades, its rhythmic antennae capture ambient sounds, spinning them into shimmering, vibrating silk threads that wrap around its body. When moonlight hits its shell, the refracted beams strike the internal threads, causing the creature to emit a symphonic resonance that physically alters the surrounding air.
features: Prismatic carapace refracts moonlight into precise spectral needles
Antennae capture rhythmic vibrations to spin into sonic silk
Internal loom mechanism weaves audible threads into a resonant exoskeleton
